INDICATIONS AND USAGE Celecoxib is indicated Celecoxib is a nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drug indicated for: Osteoarthritis (OA) ( 1.1 ) Rheumatoid Arthritis (RA) ( 1.2 ) Juvenile Rheumatoid Arthritis (JRA) in patients 2 years and older ( 1.3 ) Ankylosing Spondylitis (AS) ( 1.4 ) Acute Pain (AP) ( 1.5 ) Primary Dysmenorrhea (PD) ( 1.6 ) 1.1 Osteoarthritis For the management of the signs and symptoms of OA [ see Clinical Studies (14.1) ]. 1.2 Rheumatoid Arthritis For the management of the signs and symptoms of RA [ see Clinical Studies (14.2) ]. 1.3 Juvenile Rheumatoid Arthritis For the management of the signs and symptoms of JRA in patients 2 years and older [ see Clinical Studies (14.3 This product carries a boxed warning: WARNING: RISK OF SERIOUS CARDIOVASCULAR AND GASTRO-INTESTINAL EVENTS Cardiovascular Thrombotic Events Nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drugs (NSAIDs) cause an increased risk of serious cardiovascular thrombotic events, including myocardial infarction, and stroke, which can be fatal
label: approved

question: Which registered clinical trials study propranolol for post-traumatic stress disorder?
answer: 11 registered trial(s) in this corpus study propranolol for post-traumatic stress disorder. The highest-phase records are: NCT04985344 - Treatment of Pediatric Post-traumatic Stress Disorder With Memory Reactivation Under the I (phase PHASE3, recruiting); NCT07452978 - Propranolol for Early Secondary Prevention of Post-Traumatic Stress Disorder in Women Vict (phase PHASE2, not_yet_recruiting); NCT00465608 - Propranolol in Post Traumatic Stress Disorder (phase PHASE2, completed); NCT03152175 - Posttraumatic Stress Disorders in Police, Correctional Service Officers, and 911 Operators (phase PHASE2, unknown).
label: investigational
